meta.name: best-practices
meta.description: Apply modern web development best practices for security, compatibility, and code quality. Use when asked to "apply best practices", "security audit", "modernize code", "code quality review", or "check for vulnerabilities".

copy.tagline: 检查并改进代码的安全性、兼容性和质量
copy.tagline_en: Check and improve code security, compatibility, and quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure code meets modern security and quality best practices

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会检查并改进你的网页代码，确保安全、兼容性好、代码质量高。它会指出 HTTPS、CSP、SRI 等安全设置，以及 HTML 语义化、错误处理等最佳实践。
howto.when: 当你要求“应用最佳实践”、“安全审计”、“现代化代码”、“代码质量审查”或“检查漏洞”时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这段 HTML 代码的安全问题。
say.note: Claude 会分析代码中的安全漏洞并给出修复建议。

say.text: 如何为我的网站添加内容安全策略（CSP）？
say.note: Claude 会提供 CSP 配置示例和说明。

say.text: 审查我的 JavaScript 代码质量。
say.note: Claude 会检查代码中的常见问题并推荐改进方案。

howto.what_en: Claude will inspect and improve your web code for security, compatibility, and code quality. It points out best practices like HTTPS, CSP, SRI, semantic HTML, and error handling.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "apply best practices", "security audit", "modernize code", "code quality review", or "check for vulnerabilities".

say_en.text: Check this HTML code for security issues.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze vulnerabilities and suggest fixes.

say_en.text: How to add Content Security Policy to my site?
say_en.note: Claude will provide CSP configuration examples.
Claude will check common issues and recommend improvements.
